what_happened.line: The Planning Board held a public kickoff forum for the town master plan; no votes were taken.
Consultants presented existing conditions: demographics, housing, economy, transportation, historic and open space resources, and public facilities.
Residents raised parking, senior services, growth, community outreach and affordable housing, including 40B.
Residents gave ideas for reaching more people with the master plan survey, and one cautioned that its responses lean toward high school students.
The land use director said he will put the survey link in the YouTube description and a QR code on his agendas.

why_it_matters: The master plan sets the town's long-term direction on housing, zoning, transportation and public buildings, and its survey is an early chance for residents to shape that direction.
Survey responses that lean toward one age group can tilt the plan's priorities, so who answers affects what the plan emphasizes.
